title: Pamphlets Containing Precautionary Measures Against Air Raids And Poison Gas - Distribution In Nantao

page_data.en:
FORM NO. 3
G. M-11-36

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.
Section 1, Special Branch Sldhh.
REPORT
Date Sept. 20, 1937.

Subject (in full) Pamphlets containing precautionary measures against air
raids and poison gas - Distribution in Nantao.

Made by... C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang    Forwarded by C Chasoon

I beg to submit with translation a pamphlet
containing precautionary measures against air raids and
poison gas, copies of which were distributed in Nantao,
on September 15, 1937, by members of the Shanghai
Municipality Protection Corps, 200 Dah Chih Road, Nantao.

Sih Tse liang
C. D. I.

D.C. (Crime & Special Branches)

（批：26/9）
（批：file, Dm）
（印：RECEIVED COMMISSIONER 21 SEP. 1937 C H）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号
特务科第一股 Sldhh。
报告
日期：1937年9月20日。

事由（全称）：包含防空袭及防毒气预防措施的传单——在南市分发。

呈报人……特务侦探 施子良    转呈人 C Chasoon

谨随函附上译文一份，内容为包含防空袭及防毒气预防措施的传单。该传单的副本由上海特别市防护团团员于1937年9月15日在南市大智路200号分发。

施子良
特务侦探

副总监（刑事及特务科）

（批注：9月26日）
（批注：归档，Dm）
（印章：警务处长收讫 1937年9月21日 C H）

page_data.en:
Translation :

GENERAL KNOWLEDGE ON AIR DEFENCE

Ever since the invention of aeroplanes, war
which was formerly 'ought in a face to face manner has
assumed a different capacity, i.e. □□□, however strong
the defence works may be at the front, the planes of the
enemy can fly over to the rear and carry out their mission
of bombing at the various strategic points; they can play
havoc upon our political or financial centres, destroy
our factories, and rupture our means of communication so
as to bring about a strong pressure upon us both mentally
and materially. There is, therefore, no exaggeration
whatever in the slogan which says:"A nation that lacks
air defence is without national defence."

Briefly speaking, air defence can be classified
into two kinds, namely "positive" and "negative". The
former is the duty of the army, but the latter is the duty
of the entire population.

What is "negative" air defence? All possible
ways and means must be devised to alleviate as much as
possible the amount of damage when the enemy planes bomb
our positions. One must undergo a strict training to be
able to undertake such an obligation, but the following
points, which constitute a kind of common knowledge on
air defence, can likewise be used as a means to alleviate
certain damage if they can be carried out and fully
observed :-

(1) Control of Lights: If we have a positive
means of air defence, the enemy planes, with a view to
bringing about the realisation of the object of their
mission, usually carry out air raids at night, when the
page_data.zh:
译文：

防空常识

自从飞机发明以来，以往面对面进行的战争已呈现出不同的形态，即□□□，无论前线的防御工事多么坚固，敌机都能飞越至后方，对各战略要点执行轰炸任务；它们能扰乱我们的政治或金融中心，摧毁我们的工厂，并破坏我们的交通通讯手段，从而在精神和物质上对我们施加巨大压力。因此，“无防空即无国防”这一口号绝非夸张之词。

简而言之，防空可分为“积极”和“消极”两类。前者是军队的职责，而后者则是全体民众的职责。

什么是“消极”防空？必须想方设法，尽可能减轻敌机轰炸我方阵地时造成的损害。承担此类义务需经过严格训练，但以下几点构成了一种防空常识，若能切实执行并严格遵守，亦可作为减轻某些损害的手段：—

(1) 灯光管制：若我方具备积极的防空手段，敌机为实现其任务目标，通常会在夜间进行空袭，此时

page_data.en:
- 2 -
lights of the places below are the best guide or compass
for them. In view of this fact, we should extinguish
those lights that are not indispensable and, as regards
those which are necessary, we should cover them up so as
to render them invisible from without. At the same time,
effective means should be taken to prevent sparks flying
from chimneys and the beams of light spread by the fire
in smelting iron. It must be noted that the exposure of
the light of one lamp is sufficient to render useless the
effectiveness of control of lights throughout the region.
The staple method of camouflaging lights is to shade
the windows in a room with two pieces of thick black
cotton, and cover up electric lamps with pieces of black
cotton of at least one foot in length so as to confine
the light to within the room. Movable lights, such as
the headlights of motor cars, should be encircled with
metal and only dim lights should be put on. Electric
torches and the lamps on bicycles, etc. should likewise
be covered with pieces of black cotton. In short, all
such lights should be shaded so as to leave not a single
ray of light visible to the eyes of the raiders.
(2) Fire Prevention Equipment and Measures:
To cause a conflagration by dropping incendiary bombs
is the most brutal measure exercised by enemy planes in
attacking a metropolis. Such conflagration should be
extinguished as soon as possible, otherwise it may result
in serious damage. In ordinary times when a fire takes
place, it of course requires the efforts of the Fire
Brigade to put it under control, but in a case where
flames have sprung up in several points, the Fire Brigade
would undoubtedly be rendered unable to spare its efforts
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
下方的灯光是他们最好的向导或罗盘。鉴于此事实，我们应熄灭那些非必需的灯光，而对于必需的灯光，则应加以遮盖，使其从外部无法看见。同时，应采取有效措施，防止烟囱冒出火花以及炼铁炉火散发出的光束。必须注意，一盏灯的暴露足以使整个区域的灯光管制效果失效。遮蔽灯光的主要方法是用两块厚黑棉布遮挡室内窗户，并用长度至少为一英尺的黑棉布包裹电灯，以便将光线限制在室内。汽车前灯等移动光源应用金属圈围住，且只开启微光。手电筒和自行车灯等也应用黑棉布包裹。总之，所有此类灯光都应加以遮蔽，不让袭击者看到任何一丝光线。
(2) 防火设备与措施：投掷燃烧弹引发火灾是敌机攻击大都市时最残忍的手段。此类火灾应尽快扑灭，否则可能导致严重损失。平时发生火灾，自然需要消防队的努力来控制火势，但在多处起火的情况下，消防队无疑将无法兼顾

page_data.en:
- 3 -

for all such places. For this reason, all inflammable
articles should be removed away from premises, and in case
unfortunately they are hit by incendiary bombs, thus
resulting in a fire, it should be put out right away
before it has got out of control. It must be noted, however,
that water in the case of incendiary bombs is useless,
and therefore at least two piculs of sand and one shovel
should be ready at hand in each house. The best measure
of fire prevention is to shovel the sand over the incendiary
bomb or bombs when they are dropped. At the same time,
one or two persons at least should remain on guard in each
house to undertake fire prevention work on the premises.
They should do their utmost to help in the extinguishing
of fire in other premises, and in case same cannot be
brought under control, the Fire Brigade should be notified
by the quickest means and with the least excitement.

(3) First Aid: Of course a person suffering
from wounds or poison should be treated by a doctor, but
before he is removed to the hospital, it is best to apply
disinfection measures. If the person is bleeding, this
should be stopped.
Bleeding may be due to any of the following
three causes: (a) breaking of the arteries, (b) breaking
of the veins, and (c) bleeding from the capillaries. In
case (a) the bleeding is most forceful and the blood is
of a bright red colour. In case (b) the bleeding is quite
profuse but comparatively less violent than case (a). The
blood in this case is of a purple colour. Case (c) is the
least serious of all, the blood oozing out slowly.

Before attempting to stop the blood, the nature
of bleeding must first be ascertained. If it is due to
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

所有这些地方。因此，应将所有易燃物品移出房屋，如果不幸被燃烧弹击中从而引发火灾，应在火势失控之前立即扑灭。然而，必须注意，水对燃烧弹无效，因此每户人家至少应备有两担沙子和一把铁锹。最佳的防火措施是在燃烧弹落下时用沙子将其覆盖。同时，每户人家至少应留有一两人值守，负责本处的防火工作。他们应尽力协助扑灭其他地方的火灾，如果火势无法控制，应以最快、最冷静的方式通知消防队。

(3) 急救：当然，受伤或中毒者应由医生治疗，但在送往医院之前，最好先采取消毒措施。如果伤者出血，应予止血。
出血可能由以下三种原因之一引起：(a) 动脉破裂，(b) 静脉破裂，以及 (c) 毛细血管出血。在情况 (a) 下，出血最为猛烈，血液呈鲜红色。在情况 (b) 下，出血量相当大，但比情况 (a) 稍缓。此时的血液呈紫色。情况 (c) 是最轻微的，血液缓慢渗出。

在试图止血之前，必须先确定出血的性质。如果是由于

page_data.en:
- 4 -

a broken artery, then that part of the artery on the side
of the wound nearer to the heart should be pressed hard
with the fingers until pulsation stops. For example, when
the lower part of the leg is bleeding, pressure should be
applied on the upper part of the same. If the bleeding is
due to a broken vein, the vein should be squeezed with the
fingers on the side of the wound farther from the heart.
When the bleeding is due to a broken capillary, it can be
stopped quickly by pressing on the wound with some disinfected
material. Comparatively greater force is required in
squeezing the artery or vein.

When the bleeding has stopped, the wound
should be tightly bandaged and the wounded person should
then be removed to a hospital. Attention must be paid,
however, to the fact that the artery or vein must not be
thus squeezed for more than two hours, otherwise death may
result.

The commonest method of disinfecting a wound
is to apply a number of drops or "double oxygen water" (?)
to it, clean lightly with carbolic cotton, and then smear
it with dilute tincture of iodine.

After the wound has been disinfected and
bleeding stopped, the wounded person should be immediately
removed to hospital. If there is no stretcher available,
a short ladder covered with a cotton quilt can be used instead.
Other articles such as rattan couches and coir mattresses
of beds, etc. can also be used for such purposes. When
carrying the wounded, care should be taken to proceed quickly
and yet smoothly. The wounded person must in no case be
made to suffer jolting.
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

动脉破裂，则应用手指用力按压伤口靠近心脏一侧的动脉部分，直到脉搏停止。例如，当小腿出血时，应按压大腿上部。如果出血是由于静脉破裂，则应用手指挤压伤口远离心脏一侧的静脉。当出血是由于毛细血管破裂时，可用一些消毒材料按压伤口迅速止血。挤压动脉或静脉需要较大的力量。

止血后，应将伤口紧紧包扎，然后将伤者送往医院。然而，必须注意，动脉或静脉的挤压时间不得超过两小时，否则可能导致死亡。

最常见的伤口消毒方法是滴数滴“双氧水”（原文不清），用石炭酸棉球轻轻清洁，然后涂抹稀释的碘酒。

伤口消毒并止血后，应立即将伤者送往医院。如果没有担架，可以用铺有棉被的短梯代替。其他物品如藤椅和棕垫等也可用于此目的。搬运伤者时，应注意既要快速又要平稳。绝不可让伤者受到颠簸。

page_data.en:
- 5 -

(4) Alarm: The alarm is the signal used to
inform the people of the preparations they should make.
In the first place, all other sounds must be placed under
control so as to eliminate misunderstandings. Secondly,
the people should know the signals well. The following
are the various signals :-
Air Defence Signals:
(a) Electric or steam siren: Sound continuously
for 20 seconds, then two short notes occupying
a total time of 3 seconds, followed by a
pause of 2 seconds. Repeated six times.
(b) Alarm Bell: One strike followed by two quick
strikes. Continued thus for 3 minutes.
The urgent signal is given when the enemy planes
have come close:
(a) Electric or steam siren: Sounded continuously
for 30 seconds followed by a number of short
notes occupying a total time of about 1 minute.
(b) Alarm Bell: Quick single strikes. Continued
for about 2 minutes.
The All Clear Signal is given when the enemy
planes have left:
(a) Electric or steam siren: Sounded continuously
for 2 minutes.
(b) Alarm Bell: Single strikes. Continued for
about 2 minutes.
In addition the following two kinds of signals
should be noted:-
Poison Gas Warning:
(a) Three quick blasts of a drum or hooter
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

(4) 警报：警报是用来通知民众做好准备的信号。首先，必须控制其他所有声音，以消除误解。其次，民众应熟悉这些信号。以下是各种信号：—
防空信号：
(a) 电动或蒸汽汽笛：连续鸣响20秒，然后发出两个短音，总共耗时3秒，随后停顿2秒。重复六次。
(b) 警钟：敲击一下，随后快速敲击两下。如此持续3分钟。
当敌机临近时发出紧急信号：
(a) 电动或蒸汽汽笛：连续鸣响30秒，随后发出一系列短音，总共耗时约1分钟。
(b) 警钟：快速单次敲击。持续约2分钟。
当敌机离去时发出解除警报信号：
(a) 电动或蒸汽汽笛：连续鸣响2分钟。
(b) 警钟：单次敲击。持续约2分钟。
此外，还应注意以下两种信号：—
毒气警告：
(a) 鼓或喇叭短促吹奏三次，间隔短暂。如此持续

page_data.en:
- 6 -
tin by a short interval. Continued thus
for 2 minutes.
(b) Poisoned areas are denoted by yellow flags
in the daytime and red lights at night.
Fire Signal:
Gong sounded continuously for 2 minutes.
(5) Precautionary Measures: Ordinarily speaking,
it is the duty of the military and police authorities to
adopt precautionary measures, but in war time, both the
troops and the police having gone to the front to fight
the enemy, it is for the people themselves to undertake
the duty of self-defence. It is, therefore, necessary for
them, the people, to have themselves organized in ordinary
times, and to undergo an accelerated training as well as
to make a profound study of military knowledge before they
undertake such a task.
(6) Anti-Poison-Gas : Poison-gas is indeed a
dangerous element, but it is not at all unconquerable if
effective means for its prevention are adopted. Under the
present circumstances, it seems rather impracticable for
everyone to possess a gas-mask and an asbestos suit.
Therefore, some simpler method should be adopted. For
instance, it is effective as a means of prevention against
poison-gas if a pad filled with cotton wool is applied to
cover the mouth and nose after it has been dipped into a
basin of hot water mixed with one oz. carbonic acid, 4 oz.
nitrous acid and one oz. oil and has been slightly squeezed.
In cases of utmost emergency, a wet towel or any towel
that has been sufficiently soaked with urine can also be
used as a temporary means of prevention against poison-gas.
What is to be noted, however, is that in case of the
prevalence of poison-gas, one should walk against the wind
instead of with the wind. As regards the digging of trenches
page_data.zh:
- 6 -
2分钟。
(b) 白天用黄旗，夜间用红灯标示受毒区域。
火警信号：
锣声连续鸣响2分钟。
(5) 预防措施：一般而言，采取预防措施是军警当局的职责，但在战时，军队和警察都前往前线抗敌，民众便需承担起自卫的职责。因此，民众有必要在平时组织起来，接受强化训练，并在承担此任务之前深入研究军事知识。
(6) 防毒：毒气确实是一种危险元素，但如果采取有效的预防措施，并非完全不可战胜。在目前情况下，每个人拥有防毒面具和石棉服似乎不太现实。因此，应采用一些更简单的方法。例如，将棉垫浸入混合有一盎司碳酸、四盎司亚硝酸和一盎司油的热水盆中，稍加挤压后，用来遮盖口鼻，可作为有效的防毒手段。在极度紧急的情况下，湿毛巾或充分浸透尿液的毛巾也可用作临时的防毒手段。然而，需要注意的是，在毒气弥漫时，应逆风行走而非顺风行走。关于挖掘防

page_data.en:
- 7 -

for anti-air raids and the construction of disinfected
rooms for prevention against poison-gas, they constitute
an effective means of gas-prevention for groups of persons.
Disinfected rooms are those which are isolated from the
outside air. They are isolated from outside at their doors
of exit with two pieces of thick cloth, while inside them
are stored provisions and disinfectant medicine. In case
there are many persons in the room, they should be at the
same time provided with equipment to provide fresh air.

(7) Control of Traffic: Casualties resulting
from confusion are frequently more numerous than those
caused by bombs. Consequently, it is necessary to bring
about the introduction of traffic control as a means for
the maintenance of order as well as for the control of
vehicles, so as to enable the residents to have more
facilities in their evasion of tragedies at the same time
without causing any obstruction to the execution of relief
work.

(8) Places of Safety: Women and children and
aged men should retreat to places of apparent safety in
case of an air raid, while those who undertake the task of
refugee shelter should at once direct the people to the
location of the various places of shelter and at the same
time they should see that order in these places is maintained.
An underground chamber is of course the best place for
shelter, but in case such a place is not available, the
people must then seek shelter in open-air spaces or schools
or public recreation grounds specially assigned. Woods are
utterly unsafe for shelter in case the enemy release poison-
gas, because the gas takes time to disperse. Persons
approaching places of shelter should proceed in an orderly
manner; they should not attempt to push and struggle for
precedence, nor should they be excited. They must have
page_data.zh:
- 7 -

空袭壕沟和建造防毒消毒室，这些是针对群体人员的有效防毒手段。消毒室是与外界空气隔绝的房间。它们在出口处用两块厚布与外界隔离，内部储存有食物和消毒药品。如果房间内人数众多，还应同时配备提供新鲜空气的设备。

(7) 交通管制：因混乱造成的伤亡往往多于炸弹造成的伤亡。因此，有必要实施交通管制，以维持秩序并控制车辆，从而使居民在躲避灾难时更加便利，同时不妨碍救援工作的执行。

(8) 安全场所：妇女、儿童和老人在空袭时应撤退到明显安全的场所，而负责难民收容工作的人员应立即引导民众前往各个避难所的位置，同时应确保这些场所的秩序。地下室当然是最好的避难场所，但如果没有这样的地方，民众则必须寻求在露天空间、学校或专门指定的公共游乐场地避难。如果敌人释放毒气，树林是极不安全的避难所，因为毒气需要时间消散。接近避难所的人员应有秩序地行进；不应推搡争抢，也不应惊慌失措。他们必须

page_data.en:
- 8 -

that excitement in such case can do no good, while any
struggle on their part for precedence will only result
in a great confusion that may bring about casualties.
The above eight points are easy to understand.
So long as we are determined in our understanding and
energetic and strenuous in our efforts, we are sure to be
able to alleviate the resultant casualties and damage of
air raids. At the same time, in view of the fact that Shanghai
constitutes the first line of our national defence, moreover
as she is the first to face the consequences of an international
war if it ever breaks out, we should, therefore, be fully
prepared with all necessary means to meet future events.
There is at present in Shanghai an organization known as the
Protection Corps. It is now inviting the participation of
those who are willing to undergo training and organization,
because it aims to undertake the duty of protection on behalf of
the public. It is urged that the public will rally to the
support of this organization.

Printed and Distributed by:
The Shanghai Municipality Protection
Corps.
page_data.zh:
- 8 -

在此类情况下，惊慌失措无益于事，而任何争抢先机的举动只会导致极大的混乱，进而可能造成人员伤亡。上述八点浅显易懂。只要我们认识坚定，努力积极且 strenuous（原文用词，意为奋力、竭力），便定能减轻空袭所致的人员伤亡和财产损失。同时，鉴于上海构成我国国防的第一线，而且一旦国际战争爆发，上海将首当其冲承受其后果，因此，我们应充分利用一切必要手段，为应对未来事变做好充分准备。目前上海有一个名为“防护团”的组织。该团现正邀请愿意接受训练和组织的人士加入，因其旨在代表公众承担防护职责。吁请公众踊跃支持该组织。

印刷及分发单位：
上海特别市防护团
